    if (data.length < 12) return -1;
    if (!isFourCc(data, 0, "RIFF") || !isFourCc(data, 8, "WEBP")) return -1;

        int size = readLittleEndianInt(data, offset + 4);

    if (lossless || alpha) return 18;

}
